questions.question: Name the eight points of the compass in clockwise order, starting from north.
questions.expected_answer: North, north-east, east, south-east, south, south-west, west and north-west.

questions.question: The lighthouse is north-west of the marker. In which direction is the marker from the lighthouse? Explain how you know.
questions.expected_answer: The marker is south-east of the lighthouse, because south-east is the opposite of north-west, and when you swap the fixed point the direction becomes its opposite.

questions.question: Using Africa as the fixed point, give the direction of Europe, Asia and Australia.
questions.expected_answer: Europe is north of Africa, Asia is north-east of Africa and Australia is south-east of Africa.
